mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increases cardiac arrhythmia risk, and mefloquine is cardiotoxic with QT prolongation potential, creating synergistic cardiac toxicity.
action: Monitor electrolytes closely, maintain potassium and magnesium within normal range, perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring, and consider alternative antimalarial if possible.
